svg.title: Lab architecture: private S3 package repo
svg.desc: Publish rpm/deb to a private S3 primary in Sydney. EventBridge invokes a rebuild Lambda (ECR image) that signs repo metadata with a GPG key from Secrets Manager, writes indexes and catalog.json, and publishes the public key. CRR copies repos/ to Auckland. Each Region has a lab VPC with S3 gateway and SSM interface endpoints for dual-OS probes.
svg.text: Syd pkgs → EventBridge/Lambda (+GPG) → Akl replica · regional S3 + SSM
IAM: CRR · publisher · Lambda · Secrets · probe EC2 · CloudWatch via Lambda basic exec
